corrected_fields.summary: This ECB webpage is a navigation and download portal for the annual consolidated balance sheet of the Eurosystem. It links to CSV/XLS data files (1999-2025) and references a consolidated balance sheet as of 31 December 2025 published 26 February 2026, but presents no actual balance sheet figures in the page content. The page also notes a legal framework update per Guideline (EU) 2024/2941.
corrected_fields.why_it_matters: This page is an index/reference for data files rather than a source of actionable macro information. Researchers seeking Eurosystem balance sheet data must download external files rather than consult this page.
